note: The kernel guy's own notes in the gallery book, over the shot list's callouts. Each entry swaps one callout's words (matched by its text in shots.json) and says which of the four-colour pen's inks it is written in: blu, red, blk or grn. shots.json itself stays as it is, for make_shots.py's cards. Optional "at" (the note's top-left, in the 1920 x 1080 layout) and "maxw" move a note whose new words need room.
